settings.title: Analysis settings
settings.calib_hint: Without a calibration the swing is still measured, but ball and club numbers stay empty.
guide.title: Importing a slow-motion video from Photos
guide.step1: Open the slow-motion video in Photos.
guide.step2: Tap Share → Save to Files, and save it to On My iPhone.
guide.step3: Come back here and tap Choose videos → Browse.
guide.step4: Pick the video in Files (you can pick several at once).
guide.why_body: Picking straight from Photos compresses the video and lowers its frame rate, so ball numbers cannot be measured. Saving to Files keeps the original 240 fps.
pick.label: Choose videos
pick.hint: Pick one or several, or drop files here
queue.label: Import queue
low.title: This video is only {fps} fps
low.body: The swing can be analysed, but ball speed, launch and carry need slow motion at 200 fps or more, so they will be empty.
low.accepted: The swing will be analysed without ball data
reason.low: Confirm the low frame-rate video first
cancel.title: Stop the analysis?
cancel.body: The analysis of this video stops and nothing is saved.
leave.title: Analysis in progress — stop it?
leave.body: Leaving stops the analysis. Videos that are not finished will not be saved.
cause.NO_SWING_FOUND: The video does not show a full swing from address to finish, so nothing was saved.
cause.DECODE_FAILED: This phone could not decode the video. It was usually converted when picked straight from Photos.
cause.UNSUPPORTED_CODEC: This phone does not support the video format.
cause.FILE_TRUNCATED: The file is incomplete. It may still be downloading or copying.
cause.ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT: The analysis took too long and was stopped.
cause.OUT_OF_MEMORY: The phone ran out of memory for this video.
slowmo.title: Slow-motion speed corrected
slowmo.body: This video was saved as slow-motion playback; we corrected the speed ×{k}.
batch.body: Open each video’s result, or see them all in History.
